info.title: Fora HLA RTI Console (IEEE 1516-2025 HLA 4 Operator Terminal
info.description: Interactive TUI dashboard for Fora.Rti simulation environments.

options.name: --connect
options.description: Connect to a remote Fora RTI admin server over HTTP or HTTPS.

options.name: --token
options.description:
Send an admin API key as a Bearer token.
Falls back to FORA_RTI_TOKEN.

options.name: --timeout
options.description:
Set the remote HTTP timeout (default: 10).
-h, --help, -?, /?    Display this help and usage information.
Default Behavior:
If --connect is omitted, starts in local mode by launching a hosted
in-process Fora RTI server and opening the TUI console connected to it.
